title: FLAC extension crashes Godot 4.6
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5-stable, 4.6-stable
- 4.4-stable correctly fails to load the extension (which is built against `godot-cpp` 4.5) without crashing


### System information

Godot v4.6.stable - EndeavourOS #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 09 Feb 2026 17:16:33 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 7700S (RADV NAVI33) - AMD Ryzen 7 7840HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 54.72 GiB memory

### Issue description

I'm updating https://github.com/DeleteSystem32/godot-flac-extension for current Godot; in my fork (https://github.com/Taffer/godot-flac-extension/tree/update-4.5) I've built it against the 4.5 branch of `godot-cpp`.

Shortly after loading the `demo/` project in Godot 4.5-stable, the editor crashes (before displaying the confirmation dialog for updating the project) with:


If there's a pre-built version of the editor with debug symbols (or I can figure out how to get `scons` to build with debug symbols) I'll update this with a better stack trace.


### Steps to reproduce

1. Grab my fork: https://github.com/Taffer/godot-flac-extension/tree/update-4.5
2. `git submodule update --init --recursive` to get `godot-cpp` 4.5 if you didn't clone with `--recursive`
3. Switch to commit 3a5f7a04f29ebf95923ae9519e7ad016476262af (or f4d4d7d802fefa6a0497c046e4ab14384b310cf8) so the existing `demo/` project is in its original state.
4. Run `scons` in the root; this builds the extension binary in `demo/bin`.
5. Edit the `demo/` project using 4.5 or 4.6.
